notes: SqueekMatchEscrow is the fee-free SqueekMatch market on Sepolia. Constructor arguments are the existing SqueekNFT and SqueekToken (SQK), respectively, matching the accepted source's deployment constants and https://docs.squeekchain.com/assets/deployments/sepolia.json. It has no owner, admin or proxy and needs no initialization or deployment ETH. SqueekMining and SqueekCore are resolved through SqueekNFT at use. Asks and swaps keep NFTs in their holders' wallets until fill; bids and maker-funded swaps escrow SQK. Orders default to 7 days and allow at most 30 days. Cancelling an expired bid or swap refunds escrowed SQK to its maker.
